schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE run_events (
      event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      position INTEGER NOT NULL,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      version INTEGER NOT NULL,
      timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
      actor TEXT NOT NULL,
      causation_id TEXT,
      correlation_id TEXT,
      payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      command_id TEXT,
      UNIQUE(run_id, position)
    )
